theme_and_archetype.description: High-end luxury brand serving wealthy landlords, property investors, and Airbnb superhosts in London and Lincolnshire. The aesthetic mimics a Mayfair design studio or Architectural Digest feature—dark editorial palette, rich tactile realism, deep charcoal with warm champagne/brass accents. Focus is on depth, mystery, and premium positioning.

headings.characteristics: Editorial, elegant, high contrast. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for large headlines (text-4xl to text-6xl+). Never use for body text.

body.characteristics: Clean, architectural, refined. Use leading-relaxed for optimal legibility.

hierarchy.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans font-semibold text-[#C5A059]

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Prioritize asymmetry. Avoid centering everything. Left-align text blocks for an editorial column feel. Use large negative space (e.g., gap-16 or gap-24 between text and imagery).

buttons.primary: bg-[#C5A059] text-[#0C0C0C] hover:bg-[#A88B4B] px-8 py-4 font-sans text-sm tracking-[0.1em] uppercase transition-colors duration-300 flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm
buttons.secondary: border border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059] hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-[#0C0C0C] px-8 py-4 font-sans text-sm tracking-[0.1em] uppercase transition-colors duration-300 rounded-sm
buttons.ghost: text-[#F2F0E6] hover:text-[#C5A059] font-sans text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.1em] underline underline-offset-4 transition-colors duration-300

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-[#262626] rounded-none px-0 py-4 text-[#F2F0E6] placeholder:text-[#737373] focus:border-[#C5A059] focus:ring-0 transition-colors
inputs.label: text-sm text-[#A3A095] mb-2 font-sans

cards.style: bg-[#141414] border border-[#262626] p-8 md:p-12 flex flex-col hover:border-[#C5A059]/50 transition-colors duration-500 rounded-sm

navigation.style: fixed w-full top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0C0C0C]/80 border-b border-[#262626]/50 transition-all duration-300

guidelines.page_load: Slow, elegant fade-in upwards for typography (duration: 0.8s, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]).
guidelines.scroll_reveal: Images should reveal with a subtle scale-down effect (1.05 to 1) and clip-path reveal. Use whileInView.
guidelines.hover: Image zoom on hover within overflow-hidden containers. Slow transitions (duration-700) for a premium feel.

hero.description: Luxurious living room setup for the homepage hero background. Use a dark overlay (bg-[#0C0C0C]/60).

portfolio.description: Golden crystal chandelier (accent imagery for aesthetic pacing).

about.description: Lavish modern living area, representing Medici Living's design philosophy.

texture.description: Minimalist architectural archway, use as a subtle background element or for the 'Why Medici' section.

sections: Hero: Full-height (min-h-screen) with dark background image overlay. Large serif heading 'Medici Living', subtitle 'Luxury Renovations for Rental Flats & Airbnbs'. Primary CTA 'Book a Consultation'.
Intro/Philosophy: Large typographic statement area using Bodoni Moda. Asymmetric layout with one floating image.
Services Teaser: 2-column bento grid comparing 'Temporary Staging' vs 'Permanent Renovations'. Use hover effects to scale background images.
Featured Portfolio: Horizontal scrolling or staggered masonry grid of recent high-end projects.
Testimonials: Editorial pull-quotes in large italic serif. Simple author attribution (e.g., 'Mayfair Superhost').
Process Timeline: Vertical sticky scroll or minimalist numbered list explaining the journey from consultation to handover.
Final CTA: Dark surface card leading to the Consultation form.
Hero: Text-focused, highly elegant introduction.
Temporary Staging: Detailed section with side-by-side imagery and benefits for fast-turnaround Airbnb landlords.
Permanent Renovations: High-end architectural renovations with a focus on longevity and premium ROI.
Why Medici Pillars: 3-column grid highlighting speed, luxury materials, and hands-off experience for investors.
Hero: 'Our Work'.

Gallery: A complex asymmetrical bento grid combining wide, square, and tall images. Use 'group' and 'overflow-hidden' for elegant image zoom on hover. Include small overline text for locations (e.g., 'KENSINGTON, LONDON').
Story: The genesis of Medici Living. Rich text paired with the lavish living area image.
Values: Minimalist accordion or list of brand values.
Team/Expertise: Text emphasizing high-end design pedigree and understanding of the UK rental market.
Accordion: Use a heavily customized Shadcn Accordion. Remove default boxes. Keep it to simple bottom borders, turning gold on hover. Questions focused on ROI, timelines, and material quality.
Split Layout: Left side - Contact details (Phone: +447767939630, Email: hello.mediciliving@gmail.com) and evocative text. Right side - Formspree Form.
Form Fields: Name, Email, Phone, Property Address, Type of Renovation (Select), Timeline (Select), Message. Use the 'inputs' component style defined above.
Hero: Dynamically injects the borough name. 'Luxury Renovations in [Borough]'.
Localized Copy: Brief section mentioning specific architectural styles of the borough.
Re-used Sections: Bring in the general Services, Portfolio, and Consultation CTA to convert local traffic.

Global.Footer: Large padding (py-24). Top row: massive serif logo text 'MEDICI'. Middle: 4 columns for links, services, areas (list boroughs), and contact. Bottom: Copyright and social links.

testing.guidelines: All interactive elements must include a kebab-case, role-based data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='hero-consultation-btn', data-testid='contact-form-submit'.
